disease_label_per_paper: Rheumatoid arthritis flare with pleural effusion and arthritis after SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccination
presentation_summary: 78-year-old man with 17-year rheumatoid arthritis, RF-positive and anti-CCP-negative at onset, had maintained low disease activity for 2 years on iguratimod 50 mg/day.
Ten days after his third Moderna mRNA-1273 vaccination, he developed systemic arthralgia and marked pleural effusion on chest X-ray and was referred with suspicion of RA relapse.

Labs at 10 days after vaccination showed CRP 5.13 mg/dL, ESR 53 mm/h, WBC 5500/uL, hemoglobin 11.4 g/dL, platelets 30.3 x10^4/uL, and creatinine 0.92 mg/dL. Eight weeks after vaccination, CRP increased to 22.4 mg/dL.
Wrist MRI showed marrow edema from distal radius/ulna to carpals and proximal metacarpals bilaterally, plus prominent subcutaneous edema on the dorsal hands.

Thoracentesis showed yellow serous pleural effusion; antimicrobial smears, culture, ADA, and cytology were negative. These exclusionary workup findings and disease activity scores are preserved outside ranking.
